records.context: Owner reported that FreeNet Hub no longer opened after the public v4.3.0 upgrade.
records.claimDecision: The launcher remained alive but WPF UI creation was blocked by the startup integrity guard; ui-error.txt recorded APP_FILE_CHANGED: View.xaml.
evidenceSource: no child pwsh existed before repair

records.claimDecision: The v4.3.0 manifest was correct for Git canonical/LF source bytes. The Windows build working tree contained CRLF bytes for View.xaml and directdpi/hosts.txt, and Inno Setup packaged those raw CRLF bytes.
v4.3.0 CI allowed the defect to escape because fresh-install validation checked install success/files/release metadata but did not launch the installed UI.
records.evidenceSource: .github/workflows/ci.yml v4.3.0 windows-installer-fresh history; installed UI was not started.

records.claimDecision: Minimum sufficient prevention is three-layered: canonical LF packaging source, build-time raw-byte-to-app-manifest preflight, and hosted post-install UI launch smoke rejecting ui-error.txt.
records.rejectedAlternative: Disable or relax the integrity guard. Rejected because the guard correctly detected packaging byte drift.

records.claimDecision: Owner machine was recovered without network/VPN mutation by backing up installed manifest and temporarily aligning the two entries to already-installed v4.3.0 bytes; the UI then created a real FreeNet Hub window.
evidenceSource: post-repair child pwsh MainWindowHandle 102045310 / title FreeNet Hub
records.limitation: This was a local recovery workaround for already-installed v4.3.0 CRLF bytes, not the public packaging design for v4.3.1.

records.claimDecision: Current exact v4.3.1/R44 local candidate after canonical-line-ending correction.

records.context: Owner screenshot showed 2000 nodes loaded but no usable node rows.
records.claimDecision: Backend data was present; NodeList was visually collapsed by page layout and lacked explicit DataGrid text/header/cell styling.
records.prevention: NodeList MinHeight=190; explicit grid styles; advanced metadata collapsed by default.

records.context: First exact v4.3.1 live upgrade returned exit 7 while session was disconnected.
records.claimDecision: Two Free Net Hub-owned WARP/CFON listeners were orphaned with dead parents; the old upgrade guard blocked every listener indiscriminately.
records.prevention: Fail closed for connected/unknown/live-parent runtime; clean only owned dead-parent listeners when session is explicitly disconnected.

records.claimDecision: Exact v4.3.1/R44 artifact passed live installation, 17/17 integrity, real UI creation and node-list validation without changing the default route.
records.evidenceSource: exact live install + UI Automation + screenshot

records.claimDecision: FreeNet Hub v4.3.1 is the sole public Release authority; exact Windows/Linux assets match accepted hashes; PR, post-merge and tag CI all passed; broken v4.3.0 release object was removed while its tag/history were preserved.
evidenceSource: GitHub release v4.3.1 metadata and server-side asset digests

openGates: Trusted Authenticode identity remains external/missing and is non-blocking for functional correctness/publication.
Physical console field E2E and Android/iOS production forwarding/signing are deferred separate tracks outside the Windows/Linux desktop final DoD.
exactNextAction: No blocking action remains for the Windows/Linux public release; optional Authenticode and deferred console/mobile production tracks are separate future work.
